metadata.title: Meta Wraps Up First Phase of Equity Financing—$37.5 Billion<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Meta Wraps Up First Phase of Equity Financing—$37.5 Billion. Convertibles Yield 6.5%
Meta Platforms has wrapped up the first phase of its equity financing just a day after announcing the plan, issuing a total of $37.5 billion of common shares and 6.5% mandatory convertible preferred stock to finance its ambitious AI initiatives.
